keyVerseDR: "Seek ye therefore first the kingdom of God, and his justice, and all these things shall be added unto you." (Mt 6:33)

level1.title: God Takes Care of Me
level1.story: Jesus said, "Look at the birds and the flowers! God takes care of them." God takes care of you even more!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What can you give to God when you worry?
actions: Look at birds and thank God
level1.prayer: Father, I trust You to care for me. Amen.

activity.title: Wings of thanks
activity.intro: God feeds the birds and clothes the lilies. Write a thank-you on each feather.
activity.label: Thank You for caring for me

level2.title: Seek First the Kingdom
level2.story: Jesus said, "No one can serve two masters. You cannot serve God and money." He told His friends not to worry about food or clothes. "Look at the birds in the sky; they do not sow or reap, yet your heavenly Father feeds them." Even King Solomon was not dressed as beautifully as the lilies of the field. "Seek first the kingdom of God," Jesus said, "and all these things will be given to you."
level2.keyLine: Seek ye first the kingdom of God.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does it mean to seek God first?
What worry can you hand to God?
level2.prayer: Father, help me seek You first. Amen.

art.mainBrief: Jesus pointing to birds and lilies in a field
